answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with escrowed settlement plus a public challenge window. Every payment sits in escrow for several epochs, like fruit ripening in an orchard, before it clears. Any peer may challenge a suspect identity by staking its own funds; if several accounts prove to be shells run by one operator, their escrows are burned and the challenger is rewarded. An attacker must lock real capital behind every fake for the whole delay, while an honest seller of saffron loses only one delayed payment. Each challenge is a sonnet of evidence: short, structured, publicly checkable.
